dogecoin.text: President Trump gave a pre-Super Bowl interview to Bret Baier on Fox News, covering Elon Musk's influence on Dogecoin and his own upcoming plans.
Rumors of Dogecoin's website residing on government servers are false.  Independent verification confirms a different hosting provider.  Misinformation dispelled.

Late-night TV skewers Trump's erratic trade policy, specifically his tariff threats against Canada and Mexico, and the bizarre "Dogecoin" government efficiency debacle.  Another week, another comedic Trumpian meltdown.
